tagline: Self-hosted help desk and shared inbox.
description: FreeScout is a lightweight shared mailbox and help desk with conversations, assignments, modules, and customer management. It can pull mail over IMAP and send via SMTP.

tips.before_install: The initial admin is `admin@example.com` with password `casaos`. Change it after first login. Set `APP_URL` to your CasaOS address and configure IMAP/SMTP in the app settings for real mail flow.

author: WisdomSky
